textures.notes: Original-pixel paper ROI only; excluded shell/ports/hardware remain separately materialized.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

front.basis: Independent official silhouette sets camera scale/center only; source geometry unchanged.

back.basis: Independent official silhouette sets camera scale/center only; source geometry unchanged.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres

provenance.photoRights: Official product photographs copyright M5Stack / named manufacturer. No separate open photo license verified; retained for product reference, not relicensed under project MIT.

sources.title: Atom-Matrix v1.1
sources.notes: Reused actual corpus receipt 2026-10-26T15:19:16.940863Z; no new fetch timestamp invented.

sources.title: Atom-Matrix v1.1 LED Board Schematics PDF

limitations: No physical hardware measurements; colors are photograph-informed approximations, not calibrated materials.
PCB has no audited complete board layout and is represented only by a visible neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.
Original source plastic depth13.8mm differs from official13.9mm. Difference retained; no scaling.
v1.1 IMU is BMI270, not older MPU6886.
Paper/optical projection is isolated from molded shell; small printed markings and hidden hardware not supplied by source CAD may remain incomplete.
25 optical spots are driven by guest G27 RMT; photograph colors are not rendered as firmware output. Diffusion/brightness remain approximate.
